sample: one fixed synthetic English development sample, Samantha voice, 150 words/min
reference: A mutex protects a shared resource. Mutual exclusion allows only one thread to enter a critical section at a time. A semaphore can allow several threads to access a limited number of resources. A deadlock occurs when processes wait for each other. Virtual memory uses page tables to map virtual addresses to physical memory. A page fault occurs when a required page is not in memory. In a computer network, a TCP port identifies a service. A router forwards packets between subnets. The cache stores frequently used data.

limitations: Single synthetic voice and single run per engine; no classroom WER is established.
WER ignores punctuation and capitalization; it does not evaluate Chinese translation quality.
First-text latency is measured from paced file capture; startup is reported separately.
Host RSS excludes Apple system services. Worker RSS is not total unified-memory usage; Metal is reported separately and may overlap RSS.
Metal allocations and RSS overlap in unified memory and must not be added into a total RAM figure.
